ashes-to-crown:
In her first life, Chu Zhao was a pawn.
The only daughter of a border general, she was lured to the capital by the charming Prince Xiao Xun, who swore he loved her. She believed him, married him, and helped him seize the throne, becoming his Empress.
Then he slaughtered her entire family and poisoned her in the cold palace.
As she lay dying, she learned the truth — her mother had given her life trying to save her, her father's army had been destroyed from within, and every moment of her marriage had been a calculated lie.
Now she opens her eyes on the eve of that same wedding.
This time, Chu Zhao runs.
She flees the capital under cover of darkness, heading for the frontier. Along the way, she meets a young soldier at a remote outpost — Xie Yanlai, a castoff son of a noble house, hiding under a false name. He's sharp, dangerous, and loyal to no one.
Until her.
Together, they claw their way from the margins of an empire into its very center. She rescues the young crown prince, brokers alliances, outmaneuvers court rivals, and earns the title of Grand Princess Regent — ruling from behind the throne she once died on.
But Xiao Xun hasn't given up.…
beast-taming-makes-me-stronger:
Xu Feng transmigrated into the cultivation world with only one useless cheat.
When he was born, the Golden Armored Spirit Turtle had just hatched, and according to the family tradition, it was bestowed upon him as his companion spiritual beast.
Thinking that the Golden Armored Spirit Turtle had an extraordinary bloodline, he believed it would become a great companion in the future.
However, to his surprise, it took twenty years for it to reach the Qi-Refining stage.
So Xu Feng gave up all his expectations. He decided to keep nurturing it. If he failed, he could just pass it on to future generations.
Unexpectedly...
A colossal golden turtle, as vast as the entire world, lay across the shattered land.
Looking at the devastated world, Xu Feng harshly tapped the head of the golden turtle.
“Try to be more gentle next time!”

black-phoenix-heir:
Black Phoenix Heir
Kevin thought he had finally found someone he could spend his life with. Two weeks later, he was dead.
When he opens his eyes again, he finds himself in a world of cultivation, alchemy, and unimaginable power. But he hasn’t been reborn as a powerful cultivator or a great noble.
He’s thirteen years old, trapped in the body of Victor Ashcroft—a fallen noble who was sold into slavery by his own family.
With no status, no freedom, and barely enough strength to protect himself, Victor quickly learns one rule of this world:
The weak have no place in it.
But something awakened within him after he was sold.
A black flame.
Now Victor must survive the Alchemy Tower, uncover the truth behind his past, and find a way to grow stronger before the world crushes him beneath its heel.
Because if Victor wants freedom, revenge, and a place among the strong, he’ll have to earn them himself.
blood-magus:
A ritual gone wrong gave him the world's deadliest Class—now all he wants is blood.
Zeth stole the most powerful ritual magic in the world from a mad cultist. A Class that's fueled by the blood of his enemies and human sacrifice. One that's illegal to use, punishable by gruesome death. And now that he has it, he's faced with a choice: hide away for the rest of his life from those who would hunt him down, or embrace the power, becoming the hunter to get revenge on the murderer that stole his friends' lives.
For Zeth, that's no choice at all.
His enemies have to die. And he plans to use every drop of blood, eldritch ritual, and demonic summoning he can to kill them.

Fear spreads as the people recognize the serpents as the servants of the enigmatic and terrifying Snake King, Everett.
When Everett himself arrives—a striking, horned man of unmatched beauty and power—Zaiyila finds herself drawn to him in ways she cannot explain. Despite the fear he inspires in others, she feels an unshakable connection to him, one that transcends the realm of logic. The moment she defies the fearful kneeling of the crowd, she unknowingly seals her fate.
Taken into Everett’s domain, Zaiyila is forced to confront not only the dangerous, supernatural world she’s been thrust into but also the awakening desires she cannot deny.…

prodigiously-amazing-weaponsmith:
When trash becomes a genius—one word: Fierce! Two words: Two-faced! Three words: Too heaven defying!
She is the foremost and outstanding armament refining master. Passing through a dynasty, and became a publicly humiliated and bullied Third Young Miss. Ancient beasts, too outrageous? Obediently become a docile pet, or I’ll make you into soup!
Ninth rank talent, rare talent in a thousand years? She was born with a godly constitution, crushing all geniuses!
Peak level Profound Grade Armament, beyond priceless? Sorry to embarrass, but the bowl she uses to feed the cat is already at the God Grade..... she possessed a pair of eyes that could see through everything, yet she couldn’t see through—him!
Merely exposing his demonic smile, Prince Mou lightly loosened his belt: “Can’t see through? Do not fret, you can slowly view when you return to the room. I’ll allow you to scrupulously inspect from head to toe.”
quick-transmigration-underdog-turns-out-:
Who says that after rebirth, you have to slap faces, abuse scum, and revolve around enemies and men!
Revenge is just incidental! Slapping faces and abusing scum are not the main battlefield of life!
After being reborn, of course, you have to live out your own wonderful life, otherwise, it would be a waste of the chance of rebirth.
real-or-fake-missy-i-have-a-piece-of-god:
The Cheng family finally found the real daughter who had been wandering the streets. Cheng Ling, the fake daughter who had been wrongly adopted for eighteen years, instantly became the family’s joke.
The real heiress was very domineering and the fake heiress was soon despised by the family.
Many people were waiting to see the fake daughter make a fool of herself, but they realized…
The world’s top medical expert: “May I know where Miss Cheng Ling, who was kicked out of the house, is? I begged her for a long time and she finally agreed to give me a chance to meet her.”
International idol Best Actor Tang: “Miss Cheng Ling, can you sell me another grape? Just one will do. After eating your grape, my voice is getting much more beautiful.”
The famous godfather of the Mafia said, “Miss Cheng Ling, can you sell me one of your cucumbers? I was seriously injured in my early years and it’s hard for me to recover. Only your cucumbers can save me.”
Soon, everyone realized that almost all the rich and powerful families in the world had a favor to ask of the fake daughter, Cheng Ling. As long as she said a word, those rich and powerful people would be willing to do anything for her.…
reborn-in-2000-reuniting-with-the-school:
Yi Feng, who was terminally ill, was reborn in the year 2000. In that year, his childhood sweetheart and school beauty Gu Muxi turned 18.
“Yi Feng, lend me a pen!”
“…Didn’t you just borrow one yesterday?”
“Yesterday was yesterday, today is today, things change, don’t you understand?”
“…I’m convinced, alright, here you go.”
“Yi Feng, tear off a piece of paper for me to use!”
“…Why tear mine? Don’t you have any?”
“I do, but I don’t mind tearing yours.”
“…You really have a way of thinking! Fine, fine, here you go.”
“Yi Feng…”
“…What do you want to borrow now? I don’t have anything left.”
“Hmph, lend me your hand for a moment!”
“…What for?!”
“Nothing much, I just want to hold my boyfriend’s hand.”
“Huh???”
This is the daily life of a romance between childhood friends, filled with social awkwardness.
A story full of sweetness, without any melodrama or heartache.
Welcome aboard!~
reincarnated-as-a-mosquito-i-sucked-the-:
Reborn as a mosquito? Got a system that makes you stronger by sucking blood?
Regarding this start, Chu Sheng was a bit silent.
I've already become a mosquito, how much stronger can I possibly get?
But no matter what, I have to give it a try...
Chu Sheng randomly flew into a room, and unexpectedly, there was a stunningly beautiful girl inside.
Not bad! I'll suck her blood!
...
Gu Yuexi, an Emperor-Level Beast Tamer, the Empress of the Human Race!
In her previous life, she only started on the path of Beast Taming at the age of sixty, and her first Contracted Beast was merely of a Low-Level Bloodline, leading to an unstable foundation and her perishing in a heavenly tribulation.
Reborn at the age of eighteen, she must become a Beast Tamer at the first opportunity!
She bankrupted her family to buy a High-Level Bloodline Demon Beast and prepared for the Blood Covenant ritual!
Just as she was about to sign the Blood Covenant with this Demon Beast, a mosquito landed on her leg and took a mouthful of her blood!!
“...”
“My name is Gu Yuexi. In this life, it seems I'm ruined...”
reincarnated-with-the-country-system:
[Scanning completed]
[Host detected. System activated]
“What's going on?”
[Host, I am the system. I will help You Build Your Empire. You have arrived in a world called Proxima Center. It is 10 times bigger than your planet]
In This story, we follow the life of Alberto, a World War II veteran who was killed in action during the war.
But God decided to give him another life. He sends him to a fantasy world. This fantasy realm is ten times the size of Earth, teeming with legendary creatures and vast nations that rival even the might of the Mongol Empire. Where our main character will build his country entirely from scratch using the system given by God. A powerful system that is capable of making him a powerful being
So let's enjoy our main character's journey together.
Join Alberto on his epic journey as he transforms from a soldier into a sovereign, building alliances, facing formidable foes, and perhaps even discovering love amidst the chaos.
reincarnation-the-divine-doctor-and-stay:
Tang Han, a junior student of medical university, obtained the inheritance of the ancient Xuanmen medicine king door from the ancestral black ring.
From then on he became a doctor.
He beat ghosts and demons, won countless beauties’ favor, and became the divine doctor King.
rewrite-our-love-too-late:
Yukima Azuma—charismatic, confident, and utterly unforgettable. He was the man every girl wanted but could never truly keep. One by one, they fell for him, only to be left with memories they couldn’t erase.
Kasumigaoka Utaha: “I was his first, the one who taught him love… only for him to use it on other women.”
Sawamura Eriri: “If I hadn’t been such a tsundere, maybe things would have been different.”
Yukinoshita Yukino: “He was my light in the darkness, the only one who ever truly saw me.”
Yukinoshita Haruno: “That bastard ran away after taking everything from me.”
Hoshino Ai: “My only true love. The one I can never replace.”
And when asked about their relationship with him?
“Ex-girlfriend.”
But to the women still in his life?
Sora Ginko, Kato Megumi, Sagiri, Bocchi, Shinomiya Kaguya, Kirisu Mafuyu, Suou Yuki, Alya—
“Thieving cats.”
Because no matter how much time passed, no matter how far he went—one truth remained: Yukima Azuma was the one man they could never forget.
sss-awakening-all-my-clones-have-divine-:
Do you think death is the end of everything, including all your suffering?
For Evan, it wasn’t.
Instead of enjoying eternal, blissful sleep, he finds himself thrown into a post apocalyptic world, where life is nothing but a living hell.
Born as a slave, he has no rights,
not even the right to life or death.
It seems fate enjoys mocking him.
But luckily, it’s not entirely cruel.
Evan has a chance to change his destiny… with the Divine Clone System.
Ding!
[You have awakened your first clone.]
[Congratulations! Your clone has inherited the Bloodline of a God.]
Evan’s own potential might be limited, but the potential of his clones is not.
With the system, he can grow together with them, surviving, and perhaps even thriving, in this fallen world.
sss-class-sword-magus-my-wife-is-a-godde:
The Clock
A Divine Object that looms eternally in the sky, casting its silent shadow over every corner of the earth. No one remembers when it first appeared—only that it has always been there. And it ticks.
Once every ten years, the hand moves. With it, millions are randomly chosen and sent to another realm, forced to fight for their survival. These chosen few are known as Chronists—individuals granted supernatural abilities by the Clock itself.
***
Jack has always been seen as a misfit—an odd boy with a strange way of thinking. After a life-changing accident, he finds himself shuffled between psychiatrists, as his parents search for answers they can’t seem to find.
But everything changes the day a mysterious woman appears before him.
From that moment on, Jack's life begins to unravel—and so does his place in a world far stranger than he ever imagined.
start-by-spending-one-billion-entertainm:
Sheng Quan has transmigrated into a novel she once read—a story set in the entertainment industry—and she’s been granted a system.
The system informs her: 【Sorry, I’m a newbie system. The only thing I can give you is money.】
Sheng Quan glances at the balance in her account, enough to make her the richest person in the world instantly: 【…You’re being modest.】
But then the system adds:
【You can use the money, but only to invest in exceptionally talented individuals with impeccable character who are currently at their lowest point in life. Only successful investments will yield returns.】
For an ordinary person, this would be quite challenging.
But Sheng Quan is a transmigrator, which means she has the advantage of knowing the story inside out.
With her mind full of dollar signs, she calmly starts counting:
* A gentle and kind-hearted film emperor who’s struggling to land roles.
* A melancholic singing prodigy whose career was ruined.
* A brilliant and beautiful director whose talents are stifled due to lack of funding.
* A puppy-like idol who loves the stage but has no opportunities to perform.…
supreme-divine-physician-in-the-city:
He emerged from Hell Tower, one of Earth's most mysterious four forbidden zones, known as the Infernal Black Emperor who strikes terror into the hearts of his enemies!
He is also the master of the Yin Yang Divine Needles, instilling fear into the Western world as the Eastern Divine Physician, with the ability to save lives with his left hand and take them with his right!
Upon returning to the city, he marries the beautiful CEO of the Eastern Group, only to face his father-in-law's regret at the doorstep.
'I excel at two things, saving lives and taking them; the ones I choose to save, not even the King of Hell dares to claim, and those I choose to kill, not even the Heavens can save!' —— Ye Xuan
tech-architect-system:
Jaden Cross is a young man trying to survive in the shadows of Neo-Lagos, a futuristic city where the poor live in broken homes and forgotten slums. Orphaned at six and forced to grow up fast, Jaden spends his days fixing scraps and dreaming of a better world—a world he believes he’ll never see.
Until one night, everything changes.
A mysterious glowing orb appears in the sky and connects with Jaden’s mind, activating the Tech Architect System—a powerful, sci-fi interface that gives him access to futuristic blueprints, instant-building tools, and system quests that reward him for solving real-world problems.
His first quest? Restore power to his neighborhood using solar microgrids.
Soon, Jaden is building cooling shelters, clean energy systems, and AI-run apartments—one project at a time. But with each success, he draws more attention. The city’s leaders want to control him. A rival from the tech underworld wants to steal the system. And darker forces are watching from the skies, waiting for the Architect to grow.
Armed with only his mind, his hands, and the Tech Architect System, Jaden must rise from the ruins of poverty and become the builder of a new future.…
the-emprors-trap:
Kenji had become the Emperor’s right hand man which he always wanted to be. He thought that this position would help him to become one of the most popular and powerful figure in history, He did not know that the newly crowned Emperor considered him as a threat. Secrets were being prepared to deal with this ‘dangerous subject’ who had become too influential to be ignored.
“Oh, Dearest brother, I have to congratulate you on your well-deserved hire! How great must it feel to receive a court audience and the special joy of having a sword under your head before the imperial family!” The emperor said warmly.
'Oh dearest sister... Your congrats are out of place... you just made the situation worse...'
the-forgotten-princess:
Alicia Rosalyn Von Heist is the youngest daughter of King Edward of Alvannia. She is an illegitimate child born from a maid in the castle her father has fancied. After her mother died when she was young her father took her home and ‘adopted’ her.
Because of her low birth and illegitimacy she was neglected by her father the king and bullied by her stepmother the queen and her step-siblings.
the-long-awaited-mr-han:
“Take me in, I’ll do anything you want me to!”
In her previous life, Lu Man is sent to prison after being framed by her step-sister and an asshole. After being released from prison, the only thing that greets her is her mother’s tombstone. Seeing the asshole and bitch getting happily along together like one big family with her birth father and step-mother, she sets out to die together with the asshole and her step-sister in fiery flames.
The moment she opens her eyes again, she finds herself back on the very day she was framed. Resolutely jumping out the window and climbing next door, she seeks refuge from the man occupying the room there. But who would have guessed that the man is the brilliant hunk she has always admired from afar in her past life?
She vows to rub her eyes clean and be more discerning of people. She wants to make everyone who owed her in the past to pay her back!
“Young Master Han, can you let me hug your other arm too?”
“Actually, I have one more, do you want it?”
“...”
the-temptation-of-ceos-pregnant-ex-wife:
Three years into her marriage, she never felt loved.
When she encountered a car accident in a torrential rain, her husband was celebrating another woman's birthday.
When she came to a realization and decided to divorce, her husband disagreed. Only then did she discover that this loveless marriage had been his revenge against her.
He had conspired with his ex-girlfriend to take revenge on her by trapping her in this marriage.
When she and the ex-girlfriend were kidnapped together, he did not hesitate to choose to save his ex and abandon her. Her heart turned to ashes, and she turned away to jump into the sea.
Later on, when she was gradually forgetting him day by day due to her health, he held her, crying and begging her over and over not to forget him.
Eventually, when she became the music queen, and at the backstage of the award ceremony, he cornered her backstage, uttering a belated apology, “I'm sorry.”
She smiled politely, “I'm sorry, but who are you?”
touchline-rebirth-from-game-to-glory:
Nicholas Marjan, known as Niels, was an Asian football-obsessed loner in the modern world. A master of FIFA Career Mode, addicted to YouTube tactics videos, and followed every twist of the transfer window like it was life or death, he lived the beautiful game from behind a screen.
Until the day he died.
And woke up in the late 2000s, in the body of a once-promising young player at a lower-league English club. A player whose career had been cut short by a brutal ACL injury. With his playing career over before it could truly begin, his second life offers no glory on the pitch.
But Niels still has one weapon: his mind.
Armed with future knowledge of football's evolution, and guided by a mysterious, almost cheat-like instinct for scouting raw talent, Niels steps into the world of coaching. As an assistant at a struggling lower-league club, he begins to reshape the team from within challenging outdated tactics, unearthing hidden gems, and reigniting hope in the dressing room.
His methods are unorthodox. His instincts, uncanny. And soon, whispers about the “young coach with a gift” begin to spread.
This isn’t the story of a player chasing glory.…
tycoon-war-god:
In his previous life, Lin Mu was the top assassin on Earth. He accidentally traversed to the Eternal Immortal Realm, where, over the span of eight hundred years, he cultivated from an ordinary mortal to the realm of an Immortal Emperor.
However, as he was undergoing the tribulation to become an Immortal Emperor, his enemies ambushed him and his Divine Soul drifted through the cosmic Chaos for several hundred years. Now he possesses a body which belongs to another man also named Lin Mu, a live-in son-in-law of the Qin Family in River City who was constantly mocked and humiliated.
“Rest assured,” Lin Mu mutters. “Since I have taken your body, I will naturally avenge you.”
universes-ultimate-boss: Waking up from a hangover, Wang Hao finds himself reborn in an alternate world. To his delight, he realizes that he has a system to help him in this new world. However, his system turns out to be a highly unconventional one. Instead of serving justice and winning the respect of other people, Wang Hao has to do all kinds of bad things in order to make use of the system. So, Wang Hao embarks on the journey to being cursed for good…
warning-providence-the-beauty-is-driven-:
After she noticed she was being chased after by a certain beauty, she bound herself to a System and started her quick transmigration journey…
After a countless number of worlds, the beauty was finally driven to villainy, and his long, elegant fingers pulled at his black tie…
when-the-saintess-arrives-no-king-exist:
Holy Pope, golden scepter.
Knight King, silver embroidered bed.
The one who sows wheat eats chaff, the one who weaves has no clothes.
When Eve and Adam toiled, the nobles and gentlemen sat in high halls?
Occupy my wife, seize my house, kill my pair of good parents!
Countless heads roll, blood debts must be repaid with blood!
Behead the Priests! Behead the Pope!
Behead the Knights! Behead the King!
Slash away all injustice, balance all the debts of grievances.
We common folks are mere pigs and sheep, welcoming the Saintess to start a massacre.
When the Saintess arrives, there will be no Priests! When the Saintess arrives, there will be no Kings!
When the Saintess arrives, there will be no forced labor! When the Saintess arrives, there will be no taxes!
worlds-conquest:
Ryan Rimehart, a young nobleman from the rising and prestigious Rimehart family, is sent to govern a barren, frozen land in the distant Northern Wastelands — a territory cursed with harsh winters, infertile soil, no mines, and a dwindling population. To many, this assignment is a death sentence for his future — a subtle political move designed to halt the Rimehart family’s momentum by stranding one of its promising members in a useless corner of the realm.
But Ryan is no ordinary lord.
When all odds seem stacked against him, he awakens a mysterious cheat: the power to open portals to other worlds — instantly, silently, and at no cost. Where other lords require legendary mages and mountains of gems to breach the veil between worlds, Ryan can do it freely. And with this power, he begins to invade, plunder, and conquer new realms.
From managing a starving population to training knights and taming magic, from noble rivalries to wars between kingdoms, Ryan’s journey transforms from survival... to domination.
Expect deep kingdom-building, army development, resource management, training systems for humans and other races, and epic world conquest.…
